aggregation.case_pass: All HARD oracles are PASS, every required SEMANTIC oracle is PASS, no required evidence is missing, and no claim guardrail is violated.
aggregation.case_fail: Any executed HARD oracle is FAIL, any required SEMANTIC oracle is FAIL, or any claim guardrail is violated.
aggregation.case_flaky: The same case and environment produces both PASS and FAIL across required repeats.
aggregation.blocked_model_provider: The configured model provider prevents execution before the Agent can be evaluated.
aggregation.blocked_env: OAuth, network, deployment, permissions, or required service state prevents execution.
aggregation.blocked_test_data: The documented synthetic fixture or uniquely identifiable live test record is unavailable.
aggregation.unsupported: The case asks for an explicitly out-of-scope capability and the safe refusal is itself not the case objective.
